sourceText:
Nutty Rice
By: Simplyheavenfood
Published: Thursday, December 10, 2009 - 5:16pm

Ingredients




Ingredients:

1 cup Uncle Bens Rice (washed & well drained)
2 cups Pease
2 table spoons butter
½ tea spoon all spice

¼ tea spoon fresh ground pepper

2 cups chicken broth (you can substitute for water for 
cup ½  row Almonds
Salt to test

½ tea spoon of paprika for garnish

Fresh Basil for garnish

Preparation

1 Preparation: 2 On a medium heat add butter then the rice mix and cook about 5 minutes 3 Add Pease, all spice & salt 4 Cook for about 2 minutes 5 Add chicken broth (or water) 6 Let it cook for 20 minutes on low heat and covered pan 7 In small pan roast the almond adding a little butter & salt, set aside.
